_readme: Daily posts. Each morning (07:00 Tunis) the bot sends the owner every item dated today with Approve / Skip buttons. Approve posts the 'telegram' text to t.me/getqirat (and the Facebook Page when connected); 'x', 'x_reply' and 'tiktok' are published by the browser run. media: a repo path, or live:today / live:report for the share card built from today's data. Keep ids short (callback data is limited to 64 bytes). Rules: Strong/Neutral/Weak only, never buy/sell, no profit claims, always 'not financial advice'.
